text:
Ava (Marketing): Heads-up — planning a short customer piece tied to the April 8 webinar. Want permission to pull a 60–90s clip and a pull-quote from CedarTech.
Jamal (Producer): Uploaded raw clip and transcript snippets here: s3://redwood-assets/pulsecase/ct_raw_v2.mp4. Timecodes I like: 00:01:12-00:02:45 for the clip, and 00:03:10-00:03:40 for the quote.
Marta (Content): draft social copy below, needs legal ok on the numbers. Also will create alt copy for APAC timezones.
Jamal (Producer):
```
Tweet: "How CedarTech cut inference cost by 3x using Redwood Inference — watch the 90s clip. ▶️ https://rwd.ai/ct"
Web: "CedarTech reduced token costs and improved latency with dedicated pools — clip + quick case."
```
Sara (Legal): Quick Q — is the "3x" a customer-provided metric backed by an internal benchmark? I need the source for the marketing consent form (one line) and the signed release.
Ava (Marketing): It's from their internal ops dashboard (they shared a screenshot). @Customer Success is collecting the signed release today. I pasted the screenshot in the folder.
Diego (Sales): Please route any webinar-attendee interest to SDR channel #sdr-inbound and tag me. Can we add a one-line CTA so leads see the use-case? e.g., "Schedule a cost assessment" — ok with legal?
Sara (Legal): "Schedule a cost assessment" is fine. Still need the signed release and explicit permission to post the screenshot with numbers. If they want numbers redacted, we can still publish without numerical claim.
Marta (Content): For localization: remove the "3x" if legal requests, and change wording to "significant cost reduction". Also plan short caption variants for LinkedIn and Instagram.
Jamal (Producer): assets-bot uploaded: ct_clip_v1.mp4 (00:01:12-00:02:45) and ct_transcript_v1.txt
assets-bot: file uploaded: ct_clip_v1.mp4
Ava (Marketing): Update: CS confirmed signed release arriving by EOD. If we get it, I want to schedule social + landing page prepped by Wednesday. Jamal, can you produce a 90s cut and a 30s teaser?
Jamal (Producer): On it. Target first cuts by tomorrow noon. I'll include lower-third with CedarTech logo and a short caption. Need final quote text from marketing.
Marta (Content): Proposed quote for approval: "Redwood's Dedicated pools cut our per-token compute cost and stabilized latency across peak traffic." — want Legal to glance for phrasing.
Sara (Legal): Approve that phrasing assuming CedarTech signs off. Please send the exact quote to their POI for sign-off before we publish. Also cc legal on the approval email.
Diego (Sales): Once live, I'll coordinate a follow-up flow: webinar registrants with >2 engagement points -> SDR queue. Tagging #sdr-inbound in the publish checklist.
Ava (Marketing): Checklist to ship: 1) signed release, 2) 90s edit, 3) 30s teaser, 4) landing copy, 5) social variants, 6) localization, 7) lead routing set to #sdr-inbound. Anyone want to add?
Marta (Content): Add: alt text and transcript for accessibility.
Jamal (Producer): I'll add SRT and caption files.
Sara (Legal): I'll review final quote and screenshot. Ping me when assets folder is updated.
Ava (Marketing): Thanks team :thumbsup: Let's aim for publish window Wed 14:00 PT after the webinar follow up.
Diego (Sales): :rocket:
